# NOVA University Lisbon Research Portal

> > Institutional research information system for NOVA University Lisbon, providing authenticated access to research outputs, profiles, and academic data across all NOVA schools and institutes.

The research.unl.pt portal serves as the central gateway to Pure Nova, NOVA University's research management system. It provides secure access via RCTSaai authentication for faculty, researchers, and students across NOVA's diverse schools including FCT, Medical School, School of Business & Economics, FCSH, IMS, and specialized institutes like ITQB and IHMT.

## Key Topics

- Pure Nova
- RCTSaai authentication
- NOVA FCT - Faculdade de Ciências e Tecnologia
- NOVA Medical School
- NOVA School of Business & Economics
- NOVA FCSH - Faculdade de Ciências Sociais e Humanas
- NOVA IMS - Information Management School
- NOVA ITQB - Instituto de Tecnologia Química e Biológica
- NOVA IHMT - Instituto de Higiene e Medicina Tropical
- NOVA School of Law
- NOVA ENSP - Escola Nacional de Saúde Pública
- Institutional research portal
- Academic authentication
- Research management system

## Portal Access

- [RCTSaai - Select an account to login to Pure Nova](https://research.unl.pt/): Main login portal for accessing Pure Nova research system via RCTSaai institutional authentication
